prompt: Design a drawer pull in OpenSCAD using hull(). Two 10 mm diameter posts stand 18 mm tall, one on the origin and one at X = 60. The grip is the hull of two 14 mm diameter spheres centred on the post axes at Z = 18, so it reads as a rounded bar spanning the posts. Union the grip and the posts into one solid and use $fn = 48 for the spheres.
